text: Addressed BIDS quality-pass findings: preserved leading/trailing empty tab cells in BidsTable parsing; added BidsPath.relative and path-root guarding for JVM readTable; added total validation constructors for query/name/kind/table surfaces and removed public require traps from BIDS sources; hardened JSON number/string parsing with direct tests; introduced BidsEither traversal helper; moved PCA/eigen confound reduction behind PrincipalComponentConfoundReducer. Verification: rg scan found no require, throw, or foldLeft[Either] in BIDS sources and no non-ASCII in BIDS source/test paths; sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test passed with 48 JVM and 41 Scala.js tests. Aggregate sbt compileAll testAll is blocked outside BIDS by thresholdJVM: HierScanResult cannot extend sealed ThresholdResult from a different source file.
